name: Option-expiration pinning reversion
hypothesis: On monthly expiration Fridays after 13:00, fade moves more than 0.5% away from the nearest $5 strike back toward it.

entry.short: is_opex() == 1 and tod() >= 780 and close > (floor_to(close,5) + 2.5) and close / (floor_to(close,5) + 5) - 1 > -0.001 and close < open
entry.long: is_opex() == 1 and tod() >= 780 and close < (floor_to(close,5) + 2.5) and close / floor_to(close,5) - 1 < 0.001 and close > open

evidence.note: closing prices cluster at strikes on expiration dates
